description: Initial N0 plan normalization rejected three closed manual-front cases lacking name/id and an output flag in their original subplan. Their scripts explicitly require --output; the original subplans relied on their harness injecting it. Revision2 derives an unnamed case from its existing script basename and appends --output only after AST verifies exactly one declared output argument. Original stage/script/reference bytes and semantics are unchanged; only the global command is completed.
